claims: The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was held on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was held at Wembley Stadium in London.
Kick-off of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match was at 3:00 PM BST.
The official stream of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match started at 2:10 PM BST on the Sidemen's YouTube channel.
The teams in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match were Sidemen FC vs. YouTube Allstars
